verified_facts.text: Halepuna Waikiki is in the heart of Waikiki on the island of Oahu.
verified_facts.excerpt: Hidden away in the heart of Waikiki on the island of Oahu.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is just two minutes from the beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: It's located just two minutes from the beach.

verified_facts.text: Halepuna Waikiki is a sister hotel to the Halekulani.
verified_facts.excerpt: A sister hotel to the luxury 5-star Halekulani

verified_facts.text: The interiors are by Champalimaud Design.
verified_facts.excerpt: The interiors are by world-renowned Champalimaud Design

verified_facts.text: Guest rooms and suites are furnished in color palettes of white, gray, beige and blue.
verified_facts.excerpt: the elegantly appointed guest rooms and suites feature furnishings in color palettes of white, gray, beige, and blue

verified_facts.text: Room decor is by local artists.
verified_facts.excerpt: Decor by Local Artists

verified_facts.text: The Grand Ocean Suite is a one-bedroom suite on the highest floor with unobstructed views of the Pacific Ocean.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our signature luxurious one-bedroom suite located on the highest floor offers stunning and unobstructed views of the Pacific Ocean from every angle.

verified_facts.text: Grand Ocean Suites have sunset views over Waikiki Beach and the ocean beyond.
verified_facts.excerpt: Grand Ocean Suites feature picturesque sunset views overlooking Waikiki Beach and the ocean beyond.

verified_facts.text: Deluxe Ocean View rooms are on high floors with views of the Pacific by day and sunsets in the evening.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on high floors with sweeping views of the Pacific Ocean during the daytime and stunning sunsets in the evenings.

verified_facts.text: Waikiki Mountain View rooms look out to the mountain range by day and the energy of Waikiki in the evening.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests are able to view the calm mountain range during the day and the electric energy of Waikiki in the evening.

verified_facts.text: The Vitality Pool, on the eighth-floor Urban Escape, has an infinity pool design.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on our Eighth Floor Urban Escape, our Vitality Pool allows long distance swimmers and those taking a relaxing dip with an appealing infinity pool design.

verified_facts.text: The Sun Deck has a custom hot tub and private cabanas, all with views of the Pacific Ocean.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Sun Deck also features a custom hot tub and comfortable private cabanas…all with views of the Pacific Ocean.

verified_facts.text: Halepuna guests can choose from a selection of exclusive SpaHalekulani spa and salon treatments.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests of Halepuna Waikiki are able to choose from a selection of exclusive Spa and Salon treatments.

verified_facts.text: The SpaHalekulani bath amenities are inspired by the healing springs of Loko O'o and the cleansing ritual hi'uwai.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our exclusive SpaHalekulani collection is inspired by the healing springs of Loko O’o and the cleansing ritual “hi’uwai,”

verified_facts.text: The Garden features a Reflexology Path designed to stimulate the soles of the feet.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Garden is open and natural in design, featuring a unique Reflexology Path designed to stimulate the soles of the feet while balancing the mind and body.

verified_facts.text: Complimentary amenities are included with every stay, with no resort fee.
verified_facts.excerpt: every stay comes with a curated collection of complimentary amenities designed for comfort, balance, and connection — all included with your reservation, with no resort fee.

verified_facts.text: Guests get complimentary admission to the Bishop Museum and the Honolulu Museum of Art by showing their room key.
verified_facts.excerpt: By showing their room key, guests can enjoy complimentary admission at two of Oahu’s greatest cultural venues, The Bishop Museum and Honolulu Museum of Art.

verified_facts.text: Room-key admission also covers the Manoa Heritage Center.
verified_facts.excerpt: Manoa Heritage Center

verified_facts.text: The fitness studio has high-tech ARTIS equipment by Technogym.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience functional fitness on an elevated level with the high-tech ARTIS® by TechnoGym

verified_facts.text: Morning yoga is complimentary daily.
verified_facts.excerpt: Complimentary daily morning yoga

verified_facts.text: Guests receive an insulated Halepuna beach bag with two beach towels.
verified_facts.excerpt: Insulated Halepuna beach bag with 2 beach towels

verified_facts.text: Surf Halekulani's team offers surf and stand-up paddle experiences for novices and enthusiasts.
verified_facts.excerpt: Whether you are a novice to the sport or an ocean sport enthusiast, let our expert team provide you with an authentic adventure and taking your surf or stand-up paddle skills to a new level.

verified_facts.text: Halepuna guests have signing privileges at Halekulani.
verified_facts.excerpt: Signing Privileges at Halekulani

verified_facts.text: Chef Vikram Garg's Umi celebrates the Ocean's Harvest with seasonal ingredients and cultural infusions.
verified_facts.excerpt: Award-winning Chef Vikram Garg celebrates the “Ocean’s Harvest” featuring a menu of superior seasonal ingredients and vibrant cultural infusions.

verified_facts.text: Halekulani Bakery offers artisan breads, a coffee bar and fresh baked goods.
verified_facts.excerpt: Halekulani Bakery features artisan breads, a contemporary coffee bar, fresh baked goods, and to-go items.

verified_facts.text: A weekly Manager's Wine Reception offers complimentary wine and light bites hosted by the General Manager and management team.
verified_facts.excerpt: Once a week there is a cute Manager's Wine Reception with complimentary wine and light bites hosted by the General Manager and the management team

verified_facts.text: The hotel has partnered with the Hawaiian Legacy Reforestation Initiative to plant and maintain trees in the Hawaiian Legacy Forest.
verified_facts.excerpt: We have partnered with the Hawaiian Legacy Reforestation Initiative to plant and maintain trees in the Hawaiian Legacy Forest.

verified_facts.text: A Hospitality Suite is available for early arrivals and late departures.
verified_facts.excerpt: Access to Hospitality Suite (ideal for early arrival/late departure)

verified_facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler's reviewer found the entry-level room on the smaller side.
verified_facts.excerpt: My (entry-level) room was on the smaller side

verified_facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler notes the hotel blends in with many of the larger Waikiki hotels in the area.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel blends in with many of the larger Waikiki hotels in the area.

verified_facts.text: Summer Perks run from June through August for hotel guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: From June through August, we’re cranking up the sunshine vibes with our Summer Perks program exclusive for our hotel guests!!
